# Institute for Migrant Rights (IMR)

> IMR (West Java, Indonesia) runs a free Legal Clinic for migrant workers and publishes open research datasets on migration law and migrant workers' rights, built for empirical legal scholarship, statistical analysis in law, law and economics, comparative law and socio-legal research, and for advocacy. Most pages are in English and Indonesian.

## Datasets and comparisons
- [Court Decisions](https://theimr.org/court-decisions/): about 500 court decisions on migrants from national, regional and international courts, led by Asia, Africa, the Middle East and Latin America; coded variables (type of case, outcome, arguments, follow-up), plain-language summaries in English and Indonesian. Data: https://theimr.org/court-decisions/data/decisions.csv
- [All decisions, one page each](https://theimr.org/court-decisions/d/)
- [Migration Law Atlas](https://theimr.org/migration-law/): global, regional and national migration law, ratifications, country profiles
- [Farmworker Norms Atlas](https://theimr.org/atlas/): ranked international, regional and national norms on farm work
- [Gulf States](https://theimr.org/gcc/): migration and labor laws in comparison, six Gulf states
- [East Asia](https://theimr.org/east-asia/): Taiwan, South Korea, Hong Kong and Japan
- [Migrant workers in Southeast Asia](https://theimr.org/southeast-asia/): labor law for eight migrant worker groups in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brunei (ten de jure features), ASEAN and bilateral instruments, and emigration law of seven origin states; CSV downloads.
- [Countries of Origin](https://theimr.org/countries-of-origin/): emigration and protection law in eight countries of origin
- [Migrant Domestic Workers](https://theimr.org/domestic-workers/): international, regional, bilateral and national instruments on migrant domestic workers; 44 jurisdictions coded against ILO C189, with corridors, timeline, statistics and CSV downloads
- [Government Hate Speech: elections and non-citizens](https://theimr.org/government-hate-speech/elections/): party hate speech, votes and non-citizen protection in 34 democracies
- [Government Hate Speech](https://theimr.org/government-hate-speech/): research project on hateful speech by officials

## Help for migrant workers
- [Legal Clinic](https://theimr.org/legal-clinic/): submit a rights communication
- [Find legal help](https://theimr.org/legal-help/): map and directory of free legal help

## IMR Press (press.theimr.org)
- [IMR Press · Institute for Migrant Rights Press, Indonesia](https://press.theimr.org/): IMR Press, the publishing house of the Institute for Migrant Rights in Cianjur, Indonesia: books in international and comparative law, and Indonesian editions of Peter Singer, Jagdish Bhagwati and Abdullahi Ahmed An-Na’im.
- [Hukum HAM Internasional: Sebuah Pengantar Kontekstual · Pranoto Iskandar](https://press.theimr.org/hukum-ham-internasional/): Hukum HAM Internasional: Sebuah Pengantar Kontekstual by Pranoto Iskandar. An introduction to the legal side of the main international human rights instruments, read in context. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6021981894.
- [Membela Globalisasi (In Defense of Globalization) · Jagdish Bhagwati](https://press.theimr.org/membela-globalisasi/): Indonesian edition of Jagdish Bhagwati’s In Defense of Globalization, translated by Pranoto Iskandar. A plain-language reply to the critics of globalization, now in Bahasa Indonesia. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6027598096.
- [Muslim dan Keadilan Global (Muslims and Global Justice) · Abdullahi Ahmed An-Na’im](https://press.theimr.org/muslim-dan-keadilan-global/): Indonesian edition of Abdullahi Ahmed An-Na’im’s Muslims and Global Justice, translated by Jawahir Thontowi. An approach to reconciling universal human rights with religious and cultural particularity, drawing on sociology and anthropology. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6029648096.
- [Pemajuan Kepentingan Negara-Negara Berkembang dalam Sistem WTO · Nandang Sutrisno](https://press.theimr.org/pemajuan-kepentingan-negara-berkembang-wto/): Pemajuan Kepentingan Negara-Negara Berkembang dalam Sistem WTO by Nandang Sutrisno, translated by Susi Fauziah. The Indonesian-language study of how the WTO system can advance the interests of developing countries. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6027598034.
- [Relasi Negara & Agama: Redefinisi Diskursus Konstitusionalisme di Indonesia · Yudi Junadi](https://press.theimr.org/relasi-negara-dan-agama/): Relasi Negara & Agama: Redefinisi Diskursus Konstitusionalisme di Indonesia by Yudi Junadi. A study of sharia-based local regulations in Indonesia, arguing for separating religion and state as a third way. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6027598027.
- [Satu Bumi (One World: The Ethics of Globalization) · Peter Singer](https://press.theimr.org/satu-bumi/): Indonesian edition of Peter Singer’s One World: The Ethics of Globalization, translated by Pranoto Iskandar. The case for an ethics built on shared responsibility for one planet, with a foreword by the author for this Indonesian edition. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6029648072.
- [Standar Internasional Migrasi Ketenagakerjaan Berbasis HAM · Pranoto Iskandar](https://press.theimr.org/standar-internasional-migrasi-ketenagakerjaan/): Standar Internasional Migrasi Ketenagakerjaan Berbasis HAM by Pranoto Iskandar, translated by Yudi Junadi. A summary of the non-binding multilateral framework on labor migration: governance, worker protection, social dialogue and gender. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6029648034.
- [Tradisi Hukum Indonesia · Ratno Lukito](https://press.theimr.org/tradisi-hukum-indonesia/): Tradisi Hukum Indonesia by Ratno Lukito. What an Indonesian legal tradition might be made of, with a postscript on the challenges of the Reformasi era. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6027598089.
- [Using World Trade Law to Promote the Interests of Global South: A Study on the Effectiveness of Special & Differential Treatments · Nandang Sutrisno](https://press.theimr.org/using-world-trade-law/): Using World Trade Law to Promote the Interests of Global South: A Study on the Effectiveness of Special & Differential Treatments by Nandang Sutrisno. How special and differential treatment in world trade law serves developing countries, with Indonesia as a main example. IMR Press, ISBN 978-6029648003.

## About
- [People](https://theimr.org/people.html)

Summaries are for research and advocacy, not legal advice. Cite the dataset name, version and URL.

## How we use AI
- [How we use AI](https://theimr.org/ai-use/): AI re-confirms that none of the data used infringes intellectual property law and tests labels; it edits summaries into plain language, which people re-edit; summaries pre-written by AI are marked "unverified".

## Databases overview
- [Databases](https://theimr.org/databases/): Migration Jurisprudence from the South (umbrella), the overview of all IMR databases; welcoming remark by Pranoto Iskandar and links to all IMR databases, in five groups (Law across tiers; Destination states; Origin states; Themes; Courts). Free, no account needed.
- [Could this be human trafficking? A self-check](https://theimr.org/legal-clinic/trafficking-check/): rule-based check of a situation against the Palermo Protocol (act, means, purpose), the ILO forced labour test, Indonesian law and 14 destination countries' laws, with a printable result sheet. Nothing is stored.
- [What works where](https://theimr.org/legal-clinic/what-works/): which legal arguments for migrant workers courts accepted or rejected in each jurisdiction, with a note on what sets each jurisdiction apart.
